resources.string: ADB on port 5555, automatically at boot

One-time setup (see README): install Shizuku and start it once (wireless debugging on Android 11+, or once from a PC), then open this app and tap “Allow in Shizuku”. On Android 13+ Shizuku starts itself at boot on a trusted Wi-Fi network. This app then switches ADB to port 5555 at every boot — and if this device keeps the permanent setting, it only ever needs to run once.
